verdict.rationale: Loops is an email/SaaS platform, not an agent or agentic runtime that itself consumes external tools; all evidence shows Loops exposing an MCP server for other agents to connect to it (docs-6, docs-24, probe-4), which is the opposite direction from this story's ask (Loops acting as an MCP client plugging in outside servers). This capability is a category mismatch for a transactional/marketing email SaaS rather than an applicable-but-unmet axis.
